title: Integrative single-cell transcriptomic analysis reveals immunomodulatory hub genes and candidate compounds for HIV-associated chronic inflammation.
authors: Hasan, Md Imran; Mummidi, Srinivas; Teufel, Ashley I
one_liner_zh: 该研究整合单细胞转录组与分子对接，识别HIV炎症相关枢纽基因及候选化合物，但核心是蛋白-蛋白互作与药物结合，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制，仅转录因子调控网络分析为边缘关联。
abstract: Despite significant advances in treatment and prevention, HIV remains a major global health challenge affecting millions worldwide. In this study, we developed a pipeline combining single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) analysis with molecular modeling to identify potential biomarkers and therapeutic targets in HIV infection. Analysis of scRNA-seq data from individuals with HIV revealed 69 differentially expressed genes. Protein-protein interaction network analysis identified five hub genes (STAT1, ISG15, MX1, BCL2, and TNFSF10). Regulatory network analysis identified transcription factors and microRNAs governing the expression of these hub genes. Molecular docking simulations identified Dolutegravir and Luteolin as compounds capable of binding to STAT1, ISG15, and MX1, with favorable ADMET profiles. These compounds may potentially modulate chronic inflammation associated with persistent interferon signaling in HIV infection. Our study demonstrates an integrative approach to scRNA-seq data analysis, transforming transcriptomic data into actionable insights by identifying specific gene targets and potential candidate compounds that could inform the design of targeted experimental studies.
abstract_zh: 尽管在治疗和预防方面取得了显著进展，HIV仍然是影响全球数百万人的重大公共卫生挑战。在本研究中，我们开发了一种结合单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）分析与分子建模的流程，以识别HIV感染中的潜在生物标志物和治疗靶点。对HIV感染者scRNA-seq数据的分析揭示了69个差异表达基因。蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用网络分析识别出五个枢纽基因（STAT1、ISG15、MX1、BCL2和TNFSF10）。调控网络分析确定了调控这些枢纽基因表达的转录因子和微小RNA。分子对接模拟表明，多替拉韦和木犀草素能够与STAT1、ISG15和MX1结合，并具有有利的ADMET特性。这些化合物可能潜在地调节与HIV感染中持续干扰素信号相关的慢性炎症。我们的研究展示了一种整合性的scRNA-seq数据分析方法，通过识别特定基因靶点和潜在候选化合物，将转录组数据转化为可操作的见解，从而为设计靶向实验研究提供信息。
